frozenThresholds.note: DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS from camden_signal_test.py at the freeze commit. These are the values that decide PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL and they MUST NOT change after a real result is seen.

forbiddenAfterSeeingResult: adding, removing or redefining a fail criterion
changing the verdict logic in decide_verdict()
changing the street_key() or join_key() matching rules
changing the Spatial Accuracy stratum mapping
re-running with different flags until a preferred verdict appears
permittedBeforeAnyDataIsSeen: the four pre-registered corrections listed in preRegisteredCorrections, each of which was identified from Camden's own published dataset metadata BEFORE any Camden row was read

freezePolicy.distinction: A correction derived from publisher metadata before any data is read is PRE-REGISTRATION. A correction derived from a result already seen is TUNING. Only the first is permitted. Every permitted correction must be committed with its evidence and its date, before the download happens.
freezePolicy.noteOnClassificationKeywords: The original policy forbade 'changing the contravention classification keywords' AFTER seeing a result. C4A did not change them: TURNOVER_CODE_HINTS and PROHIBITION_CODE_HINTS are retained byte-for-byte and remain reachable as a counted fallback. What changed is that classification is now primarily a lookup against a frozen authoritative codebook, and that change was made BEFORE any data was seen. Self-test check c4a:keyword-heuristic-retained-as-fallback-only asserts the retained heuristic still exhibits its documented defective behaviour, so a silent rewrite of the fallback would fail the suite.

preRegisteredCorrections.title: The bay dataset is 7hiv-3r9k, not t4s2-xa5a
preRegisteredCorrections.evidence: Camden's own metadata: t4s2-xa5a is assetType 'map', displayType 'visualization_canvas_map', and its columns array is EMPTY. Its modifyingViewUid and its map series dataSource.datasetUid both point to 7hiv-3r9k ('Parking Bays', assetType 'dataset', displayType 'table', 15,107 downloads).
preRegisteredCorrections.consequence: Downloading t4s2-xa5a expecting tabular bay data will not work. The tabular source is 7hiv-3r9k.
preRegisteredCorrections.change: Use 7hiv-3r9k as the bay input. No code change.

preRegisteredCorrections.title: Adapter candidates do not match two real bay column names
preRegisteredCorrections.evidence: 7hiv-3r9k publishes 'Parking Spaces' (fieldName parking_spaces) and 'Parking Bay Length Metres' (fieldName parking_bay_length_metres). BAY_FIELD_CANDIDATES for spaceCount lists 'number of spaces', 'no of spaces', 'spaces', 'space count', 'approximate number of spaces', 'capacity' - none of which equals 'parking spaces' after cleaning. Same for bayLengthM versus 'parking bay length metres'.
preRegisteredCorrections.consequence: SEVERE AND SILENT. spaceCount and bayLengthM are optional fields, so the adapter would NOT raise. Every bay would load with spaceCount None, capacity would be unknown everywhere, streetCountWithIndex would be 0, and F3 would fire as 'insufficient capacity coverage'. The run would report a coverage FAIL caused by our own adapter rather than by Camden's data - exactly the wrong conclusion.
preRegisteredCorrections.change: Add 'parking spaces' and 'parking bay length metres' to the candidate lists, OR supply them via --field-map. --field-map is preferred because it requires no code change and is recorded in the report at inputs.fieldMapOverrides.

preRegisteredCorrections.title: 35.9% of the PCN dataset is not parking
preRegisteredCorrections.evidence: 4k7m-4gkk ticket_type distribution over 495,814 rows: O/S TMA 312,203 (63.0%), MTC 170,747 (34.4%), BUS 7,032 (1.4%), CCTV TMA 5,194 (1.0%), VDA 491 (0.1%), PFS 147 (0.03%). ticket_description confirms: On Street Contravention, Moving Traffic Contravention, Bus Lane Contravention, CCTV Parking Contravention, Vehicle Driven Away, Prevented From Serving.
preRegisteredCorrections.consequence: Moving-traffic and bus-lane contraventions are not parking events. Including them would attribute a bus-lane camera's throughput to parking pressure on that street. The top PCN streets are dominated by junction-qualified camera locations - 'TOTTENHAM COURT ROAD W1 BY JUNCTION WITH CHENIES STREET' alone has 27,940 rows (5.6% of the entire dataset) - which is consistent with moving-traffic enforcement rather than parking.
preRegisteredCorrections.change: Pre-declare the inclusion filter: ticket_type IN ('O/S TMA', 'CCTV TMA'), i.e. On Street Contravention plus CCTV Parking Contravention = 317,397 rows (64.0%). VDA and PFS (638 rows, 0.1%) are EXCLUDED and reported as excluded, not silently dropped. The filter is declared here, before any data is read, and must be recorded in the run report.

preRegisteredCorrections.title: F1 would be silently inoperative on real Camden data
preRegisteredCorrections.evidence: contravention_code values are London numeric codes with suffixes - observed 33H (76,882), 52M (73,148), 12R (72,219), 11 (68,427). classify_contravention() matches keywords in the code plus its description. Numeric codes contain no keywords, and no contravention-description column was confirmed in positions 1-5 or 9-30 of the dataset.
preRegisteredCorrections.consequence: SEVERE. Every real row would classify as UNCLASSIFIED, so prohibitionShareOverall would be None, indicator I2 could never trigger, and F1 (signal dominated by enforcement deployment) could NEVER fire. decide_verdict() treats a non-firing criterion as passed, so the harness could return PASS or PARTIAL while the single most important confound was never tested. That is a false negative on the criterion that matters most.
preRegisteredCorrections.change: Either (a) supply an authoritative London Councils contravention-code to class mapping as data, not as keywords, or (b) treat F1 as UNEVALUABLE on this dataset and cap the verdict at PARTIAL with the reason recorded. Option (b) is the honest default if no authoritative mapping is sourced. What must NOT happen is a PASS that silently skipped F1.

The dataset DESCRIPTION documents it explicitly, but the fetch proxy failed on metadata chunks 6-7 (positions 31+) so the column itself was not retrieved. The ward and coordinate column descriptions reference THREE location types - 'Civil Enforcement Officer location, fixed CCTV location or mobile CCTV location' - so a MOBILE_CCTV stratum may exist that the harness does not model.

strategicFind.whyItMatters: Camden's bay inventory already carries the cashless-payment location identifier. That is the join key to RingGo / MiPermit session data (PTE-TEL-002 class A) - and it joins on an ID, not on a street string. If session data for Camden is ever obtained, sessions can be attached to bays and their capacity directly, bypassing the street-matching problem entirely. This is the strongest concrete bridge found so far between the enforcement-exhaust path and the payment-session path.

c4aAmendment.title: Authoritative contravention-code classification replaces the keyword heuristic
c4aAmendment.executes: C4 option (a): 'supply an authoritative London Councils contravention-code to class mapping as data, not as keywords'. C4's own pre-registered text authorised this route.
c4aAmendment.status: COMMITTED BEFORE ANY CAMDEN ROW WAS READ - therefore pre-registration, not post-hoc tuning.
c4aAmendment.trigger: Executing C4 falsified C4's planned remedy. The audit ran the frozen keyword classifier against the authoritative London Councils descriptions: agreement 42/66 = 0.636, recognising only 9 of 18 declared turnover codes against 31 of 46 declared prohibition codes. Because prohibitionShareOverall is PROHIBITION_TYPE over ALL classes, that asymmetric attenuation biased it UPWARD by +0.030 to +0.074 - enough to carry a true share of 0.45 to a reported 0.524 and cross the frozen F1 threshold of 0.50 unaided. A false F1 trigger yields FAIL, whose pre-registered reading is to drop the PCN-exhaust source class as enforcement-biased, so the defect could manufacture the evidence for abandoning the approach.
c4aAmendment.secondDefectFound: The PTE-TEL-003 fixture did not merely use the classifier's own vocabulary - it invented codes that contradict the authoritative codebook. Five of its nine codes carried the wrong authoritative class and one did not exist: fixture ('30','Parked without a permit in a controlled parking zone') is authoritatively 'Parked for longer than permitted' = TURNOVER, the cleanest duration-demand code in the list, sitting in the fixture's PROHIBITION bucket; fixture ('31','Parked in a permit bay without a permit') is authoritatively a box-junction moving-traffic offence = NOT_PARKING; fixture code 03 does not exist in the source at all. The 14/14 green self-test was therefore validating the classifier against fabricated ground truth.
